requiredFindings.title: The hand-written successor-carrier alternative needs amendments to its governing authorities
requiredFindings.detail: LD-D2B0-A permits D2b-3 and D2b-4 to use hand-written typed successor carriers without ever generating them. This changes more than the timing of D2b-0 and its blind refresh. M3-D item 10 (PROPOSAL-r5.md:381, also PROPOSAL-r3.md:335) requires conversion into generated carrier types. Both accepted FA-2 and RUST3-LIM materialization-map.json standing passages require source-map rows, registry re-pinning and regenerated carriers. The proposed quoted replacements amend only D2b PLAN-r3.md, leaving these governing requirements in force. Consequently a codec taking the new manual branch can satisfy the amended implementation plan while violating those authorities.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Either keep generated successor carriers mandatory in D2b-3/D2b-4 and defer their generator extensions and corresponding blind refreshes, or explicitly propose and review the necessary narrow amendments to M3-D item 10 and both successor materialization obligations. For an alternative-carrier exception, retain the schema checks, complete successor-aware depth computation, protocol separation, no serde wire decoding, and refresh obligation for every actual generator-closure change.
